segments.name: Card issuing
segments.description: Provides a single global cloud-based open API platform for card issuing and transaction processing to businesses launching debit, prepaid and credit programs.
segments.evidence: As such, the Company operates as a single operating segment and reporting unit.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay Marqeta for processing card transactions and for card program management and value added services on its platform.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company provides a single, global, cloud-based, open API platform for modern card issuing and transaction processing, and primarily earns revenue from processing card transactions for its customers.
